extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors and prospective article creators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia page/title (how to check whether an article exists, account requirements, alternatives to direct creation, and troubleshooting deleted or delayed pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users may create pages; if you lack these privileges, use alternate workflows (article wizard, request a new article) or create an account and wait until autoconfirmation criteria are met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request-a-page if you cannot create directly
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create an article directly (e.g., unfamiliar with formatting or not autoconfirmed), submit a draft via the article wizard or make a request so experienced editors can review and create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Buck Henry Get Smart" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always search Wikipedia to avoid duplicating content or creating near-duplicate titles; try alternative spellings or related terms during the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for incoming links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If other pages link to the title, investigate whether a redirect or different title is appropriate; linked usage can indicate an existing topic covered under another name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay and purge advice
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a newly created page isn't immediately visible, wait briefly or use the purge function to refresh server caches before assuming it doesn't exist or was deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify capitalization variants and add redirects from common alternative capitalizations to the canonical title to help readers find the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate deletion reasons via the deletion log to learn whether content failed to meet notability, sourcing, or other community standards; use that information to improve or contest deletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: General diagnostic steps when title not found
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name. Please search for the title, check alternative capitalizations, and look for links or deletion entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow a checklist: search for the term, examine links, verify capitalization, check deletion logs, consider redirects, or use the article wizard/request process before creating a new page to avoid conflicts with existing content or policies.
